name: hcapp_processPayment
description: Processes a single payment for a hasher at an event or for membership/haberdashery (productType). Handles payment type codes 1-8 and 100 (bank transfer confirmation). Creates HasherEventMap if not present. Cancels prior payments before inserting new ones. Access token validated against a compound string: DeviceSecret + hemId + '#' + userId + '#' + int(amount) + '#' + eventId. Returns an adHoc result row then delegates to syncEventAdminData or syncUserData.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Token validated against compound string including hemId, userId, amount (as int), and eventId.

parameters.name: userIdWhoPaid
parameters.description: The hasher being paid for. Resolved from @hasherEventMapId if null.

parameters.name: hasherEventMapId
parameters.description: Specific HEM record. Resolved from userId+eventId if null.

parameters.name: paymentType
parameters.description: 1=not paid, 2=free, 3=cash, 4=bank transfer, 5=cash other, 6=hash credit, 7=bank transfer other, 8=credit other, 100=confirm bank transfer.

parameters.name: paymentAmount
parameters.description: Amount paid. Required when paymentType < 100. Cast to INT for token derivation (loses decimal precision).

parameters.name: minimumAttendenceValue
parameters.description: Minimum attendance state to set when paying.

parameters.name: transactionTimestamp
parameters.description: Payment timestamp as string. Cast to DATETIME — no error handling on invalid formats.
parameters.typeMismatch: NVARCHAR(50) cast to DATETIME — loses timezone, brittle.

parameters.name: specialRunPrice
parameters.description: Override price for this hasher. When set, updates HasherKennelMap.DiscountAmount if @useSpecialPriceAsDefault=1.

parameters.name: useSpecialPriceAsDefault
parameters.description: When non-zero and specialRunPrice is set, saves the price as a permanent discount for the hasher at this kennel.

rowsets.name: StandardErrors
rowsets.description: Standard error format. errorType=2 for null userId/eventId/null-negative-amount. errorType=3 for auth failure.

rowsets.name: AdHocPaymentResult
rowsets.description: Single row returned after payment is processed.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.HasherEventMap — if no existing HEM for userId+eventId
UPDATE HC.HasherEventMap SET AttendenceState, RsvpState, UserStartEvent — on payment
UPDATE HC.Payment SET CancelledDate — cancels prior payments before new insert

codeSmells.issue: No transaction — multiple writes without BEGIN TRANSACTION
codeSmells.detail: HEM INSERT, Payment INSERT, HEM UPDATE, Hasher credit update all occur outside a transaction. Partial failures leave inconsistent state.

codeSmells.issue: @paymentAmount cast to INT for token derivation — loses decimal precision
codeSmells.detail: Token: @deviceSecret + hemId + '#' + userId + '#' + cast(cast(@paymentAmount AS INT) AS nvarchar(50)) + '#' + eventId. Any payment with cents (e.g. $5.50) is treated as $5 in the token.

codeSmells.issue: @transactionTimestamp is NVARCHAR cast to DATETIME — brittle, no error handling
codeSmells.detail: If the client sends an invalid date string, the CAST will throw an unhandled exception.
money type has 4 decimal places but 4-byte precision — DECIMAL(10,4) is the project standard.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change payment type codes without updating all callers
Never change the token derivation formula without updating all callers
